resources.string: During a call the screen ignores touch. The call stays visible; hang up with the red key.
A call is active (or a test is running). Keys still work.
Turn it on so cheek and pocket taps can\'t hit the call screen.
Allow “Display over other apps”, otherwise touch can\'t be blocked.
With Battery Saver on, this phone closes apps soon after the screen locks, this one included, and the next call is not protected.
Closes this app after locking · turn it off
Block touch while a call is active
Optional · also spots a 2nd call ringing during a call
Answer and reject with the keys, not the screen
Swipe can\'t unlock · left key, then *
Turn on “Call Touch Lock” in Accessibility
Not running · turn it off and on in Accessibility

Lock screen, keys only: touch is ignored while the lock screen is showing, so the phone can\'t be swiped open in a pocket. Unlock with the left key, then *. A ringing alarm still takes touch; calls follow the call settings. Does not read the screen or key presses.
Touch is ignored now; keys keep working

Works with calls on either SIM. The call screen stays visible; only touch is swallowed, so the red key, volume and the keypad keep working. A ringing call is blocked too (answer or reject it with the keys) unless you turn that off.
